description: This file contains the PHP source code defining the Location model class within the Opencart admin localisation namespace. It includes methods for managing location data such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving location records from the database.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: A model class for managing location entities within the Opencart admin localisation module.

methods.name: addLocation
methods.description: Inserts a new location record into the database with data provided in an associative array.

methods.name: editLocation
methods.description: Updates an existing location record identified by location_id with new data.

methods.name: deleteLocation
methods.description: Deletes a location record from the database based on location_id.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific location identified by location_id.

methods.name: getLocations
methods.description: Retrieves a list of locations with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalLocations
methods.description: Returns the total number of location records in the database.
